messages:
ashok: Heads up — apiserver 503 spike in us-west2 during a big GPU pool scale-up (~120 instances). Seeing leader election noise in etcd and controller-manager flipflop. Anyone else seeing the same?

maria: yep, hit alerts ~1825551095. 503s in us-west2 across a/b/c. Lots of watch reconnects and high apiserver request_latencies. Logs:

```
I0321 18:18:12.345678 1 wrap.go:42] apiserver: error streaming watch: net/http: timeout awaiting response headers
I0321 18:18:13.112233 1 handlers.go:234] GET /api/v1/pods?watch=true: 503
```

jonathan: infra note: new GPU hosts spun with MTU=1400 while fleet standard is 1500. CNI didn't reconcile, so fragmentation + retransmits. Kernel on new nodes shows TCP retrans/frag: `dmesg`: "IP: fragmented packet dropped".

li: saw etcd leader election at 1825551088 (term increased). Also compaction job started at 1825551087. If compaction coincides with network tail it can delay raft heartbeats -> leader elections.

maria: controller-manager is flipping leader every ~18-22s which re-enqueues many controllers -> thundering herd against apiserver. That magnifies 503 cascade.

ashok: quick mitigation plan: 1) throttle GPU autoscaler launch rate, 2) restart CNI on newly-provisioned hosts to force MTU reconcile, 3) delay compaction window for 10m, 4) temporarily route heavy workloads to Dedicated pool.

jonathan: throttling autoscaler now. Edited configmap: `kubectl -n kube-system patch cm gpu-autoscaler --type merge -p '{"data":{"maxBurst":"8"}}'` (was 40). Rolling launch rate grabbed down.

ashok: initiating DaemonSet restart for CNI on us-west2-b new nodes: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart ds/calico-node` (or cilium depending on image). Doing gradual restarts.

maria: after first wave of CNI restarts, ping packet loss to etcd endpoints dropped from ~8% to ~0.6%. apiserver 503s decreased but still a few.

li: bumped controller-manager lease-duration heuristic in a temp patch (increase lease retries/backoff) to reduce leader jitter. Will propose longer-term tuning in follow-up.

ashok: created short hold on compaction: added a temporary guard in the compactor cron to skip if cluster instability detected (apiserver 5xx > 1%).

maria: note on cost: unbounded autoscale churn is burning GPU slots and billing. We should discuss reserved Dedicated capacity for predictable baseline (avoid noisy scale bursts). Opening a follow-up doc.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 — us-west2 controlplane-thump. Pager duty alerted.

jonathan: next steps for postmortem: 1) add MTU autodetect & enforce in onboarding flow, 2) audit autoscaler burst defaults and set sensible global caps, 3) schedule controlled compaction window (avoid overlap with heavy scaling), 4) add apiserver-side graceful backpressure for controller requeues.

ashok: Agreed. If 503 rate stays <0.5% for next 10m we'll demobilize. Thank you all for fast responses. :thumbsup:

li: attaching tcpdump excerpt to the incident (snip shown inline): `tcpdump: ip frag reassembly timeout, 12 fragments lost` — suggests fragmentation due to MTU mismatch.

maria: marking this thread for follow-up on runbook updates and cost impact analysis. Will tag infra & product for Dedicated sizing.

ashok: closing ops loop here, keeping incident open until 30m stable. Will update INC-2026-042 with timeline and mitigation steps.
